name: io.github.noahowsh/puckapi
title: PuckAPI
description: The hockey data API. Stats, odds, and everything between. REST API and MCP server.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your PuckAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at puckapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: All 32 active NHL teams with divisions, conferences, and arenas

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Current standings with points, wins, losses, goal differential, and advanced stats

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming NHL games for the next N days

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find NHL players by name, team, or position

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Query games by date, team, season, game state, or type

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Detailed stats for a specific team with advanced metrics

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Season stats for skaters and goalies with per-game averages

tools.name: get_goalie_stats
tools.description: Goalie leaderboard sorted by save%, GAA, GSAX, or wins

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Betting odds by game with bookmaker filters. Moneylines, spreads, totals.

tools.name: get_game_detail
tools.description: Full game detail including odds, goalie starts, and scoring

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Matchup history between two teams with win/loss records

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Time-series odds movement grouped by bookmaker
